serviceName: A root domain for a Computer, at Cloudflare
description: Points a root domain (example.com) at a Heaven organization, and adds the TXT record that shows the domain is that organization's. For Cloudflare DNS only: Cloudflare flattens a CNAME at a zone's own name. Heaven applies it without a host and only at Cloudflare. hostRequired is set only because a CNAME at @ requires it (DCTL1012); Cloudflare ignores it.
variableDescription: label: the first label of the organization's address, LABEL.domains.heaven.dev: 3 to 32 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens.
